scope: demo-city organizational source memory only; no operational permissions

graphs.tests: validated B11 document UUID graphs, B11 canonical or explicitly configured B10 investigation proof graphs

canonical_strategy: Immutable v3 registry; version-bound strict Document plus validated CivicDocumentVersion companion via compatible additive0003. No SDK labels/indexes in canonical graph. Existing KnowledgeProcedure ORGPROC IDs/document_ref/status PROPOSED; string node version projected explicitly to integer MCP version. No automatic verification.

ingestion.authoritative_reference: Document+companion atomic fenced commit only after actual SDK chunk text/hash/vector verification; READY required
ingestion.retry: Complete indexed source reused by same ID/hash; partial SDK ingestion fails closed for explicit repair; never acknowledge partial document
ingestion.revocation: Explicit operator/reason, previous metadata retained atomically in history_json; no fallback to superseded version
ingestion.version_update: version>1 requires explicit supersedes of latest registered same-owner version; earlier effective history retained
ingestion.indexing_validation: Before successful replay/new registration and retrieval: actual Chunk embedding VECTOR index OPERATIONAL, dimension64 cosine; Chunk text FULLTEXT; exact bounded chunk ID count; finite64 vectors matching deterministic hash embedder within float32 tolerance. Invalid/missing state raises SDK_PARTIAL_REQUIRES_REPAIR, no automatic repair. Does not prove ANN internal membership or cross-graph atomic consistency.

retrieval.strategy: Actual SDK LocalRetrieval; graph-scoped GRAPH.RO_QUERY, lexical hash64 embedding offline baseline
retrieval.assertions: PROPOSED; review of source does not verify physical/causal truth
retrieval.current_version: highest registered version effective at cutoff, superseded/revoked sources cannot silently fall back; historical cutoff supported
retrieval.source_revisions: recheck canonical document revision before acknowledgment; disable civic-only cache for organizational tools
retrieval.security: trusted exact-key private capability, closed manifest, source whitelist/checksum/path/symlink/injection checks; no evaluator artifacts or autonomous operations
retrieval.eligible_fallback: After actual global SDK top12, read and verify bounded eligible SDK chunks (<=20 sources, <=128 chunks/source); include applicable source chunks omitted by ranking, explicitly flag ELIGIBLE_SOURCE_FALLBACK. Not metadata-only or learned relevance evidence. Existing max5citations/max800chars applies; truncated means additional verified eligible chunks omitted.

memory_layers.episodic: Immutable B09 assessment corrections: temporal visibility before limit; latest assessed_at/id DESC with max_results+1 lookahead <=101; selected results assessed_at/id ASC. Truncation exposes omitted older history, exact total unknown; OMITTED_PREDECESSOR IDs are historical references, never returned evidence. No schema change to existing outcome_summary/envelope.
memory_layers.semantic: existing B05 topology-qualified case retrieval and B09 classification; never promote correlation
memory_layers.procedural: source-backed versioned citations through existing two MCP tools

limitations: Offline lexical/extraction baseline is not genuine model-quality proof
SDK internal partial ingestion quarantined for explicit repair; automatic recovery covers complete SDK ingest to canonical registration boundary
B10 genuine live gates deferred explicitly; OPEN/PARTIAL
effective_date_mapping: Frozen manifest calendar dates explicitly denote UTC start-of-day validity in this synthetic demonstration. Originals retained; not fabricated observation/review timestamps.
